vm4mtq.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
vm4mtq.description_zh:

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆

13o9ddz.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.
Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，相应的，他们每个人都在这份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓也落荒而逃，分散躲进了黑暗中。无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

我们的一个匿名线人告诉我们，阿灵顿帮的领导人，马尔特克斯·阿灵顿 的孩子，莱斯·阿灵顿，被发现在一个科瓦莱什转运中心取快递。我们将为您提供我们认为他们现在所在位置的的坐标。

莱斯是一位经验十分丰富的飞行员，据说他的飞行时间比他出生到现在走路的时间还多，因此他通常都是该犯罪组织的撤离飞行员。可能有必要组织一艘额外的支援舰船以防止目标可能的逃脱行为。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.
Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.
Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to [LOCATION] to begin.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 3 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

tvgbaz.description_en:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.
A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.
Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.
This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.
Stows out.
tvgbaz.description_zh:
这些异种威胁的杂种就像是蟑螂。每当你以为彻底消灭他们时，他们又会顷刻复生。看样子，他们又回到了往日的疯狂，正试图策划一些大事。具体是什么我们不得而知，但肯定是一场混乱，因此我们已获得许可，在事情发生之前予以制止。

据说一群异种威胁的高层正在 [LOCATION] 秘密会面，计划或发泄情绪，或者做其他事情，但我们打算捣毁这个聚会。或者，由你来完成。

前往那里，消灭你遇到的所有人。没错，我敢肯定那些大人物会参与进战斗，这是他们一贯的做法。

这将会很艰难。尽管我讨厌异种威胁，但他们在战斗中确实很厉害，所以要小心，如果可以的话带上帮手。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

我刚收到那个为我运输装备的飞行员的消息，听起来他们在执行任务时遭遇了袭击。我需要派人去他们的位置，把他们飞船里剩下的四个包裹拿回来带给我。

在他们通讯中断之前，他们告诉我袭击他们的飞船不是普通的运输船。那些混蛋配备了非常厉害的武器。带上一个团队，把我的东西拿回来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]。整个情况太混乱了，如果你们能完成这个任务，我愿意多付一些报酬。

-刺痛

CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.
However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.
We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.
TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.
Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

合约：采矿订单
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
我们的一支勘探小队近期确认，位于尼克斯星系基格小行星带中，设有 QV 碎岩站的小行星内部蕴藏一种稀有矿石“萨达瑞晶(Sadaryx)”。
